body.ht: Granmè pare pou fèt la. Men sou tab la, se sèlman ti moso gato ki rete. Ki kote nou pral chèche?
body.en: Grandma is ready for the party. But only cake crumbs remain on the table. Where will we look?

body.ht: Ti moso gato yo mennen bò yon chèz. Ti frè a kache dèyè li ak yon riban wouj. Li di li bezwen èd pou yon sipriz.
body.en: The crumbs lead to a chair. Your little brother hides behind it with a red ribbon. He says he needs help with a surprise.

label.ht: Mande l mennen nou jwenn gato a
label.en: Ask him to take us to the cake

body.ht: Pa gen gato! Gen yon nòt: “Fèt la deplase. Chèche kote fanmi an renmen chita ansanm.”
body.en: No cake! A note says: “The party has moved. Look where the family likes to sit together.”

label.ht: Rasanble tout moun nan salon an
label.en: Gather everyone in the living room

body.ht: Riban an dekore tab la. Nou pote Granmè nan jaden an: gato a la! Paske nou te ede, tout moun pare pou rele “Sipriz!” ansanm.
body.en: The ribbon decorates the table. We bring Grandma to the garden: there is the cake! Because we helped, everyone is ready to shout “Surprise!” together.

body.ht: Nou jwenn gato a sou galri a, byen kouvri. Nou pote chèz ak ji pou tout moun. Chwa nou fè fèt la tounen yon piknik an fanmi.
body.en: We find the cake on the porch, safely covered. We bring chairs and juice for everyone. Our choice turns the party into a family picnic.

body.ht: Lè tout moun kòmanse chante nan salon an, ti frè a antre ak gato a. Li t ap tann chante a! Nou chwazi mizik olye nou kontinye chèche.
body.en: When everyone starts singing in the living room, your little brother brings in the cake. He was waiting for the song! We chose music instead of continuing the search.
